invariants.rationale: tileSet is used throughout the method and methods are called on it, so it cannot be null at exit.
imageWidth and imageHeight are used to compute tile layout; negative values are not meaningful for dimensions.
GIDs (global tile IDs) in tiled maps are non-negative integers; negative IDs would be invalid.
Tile dimensions must be positive to correctly divide imageWidth and imageHeight.
tileElements is iterated over, so it cannot be null at method exit.
